data.name: Bloodbound Spell
data.description: A cabalist gets an advantage when casting spells against bleeding foes. Whenever the cabalist casts a spell against a foe that is taking bleed damage, the foe takes a -1 penalty on its saving throw against the spell (or to its AC if the spell requires an attack roll). This penalty increases to -2 if the spell is from the necromancy school.
